description: ORES Gaz - points de prélèvement et consommation par localité, client et secteur is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ORES. Afin de mesurer l’impact de ses Open Data, Ores est intéressée d’être tenue informée des réutilisations qui seront faites des données mises à disposition. Nom du rapport: Nombre de points de prélèvement par localité, type de client et statut Niveau d'agrégation: Le dataset contient des. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal lists 8 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Energie. Its keywords are ore, gaz, prélèvement. The portal shows 4,351 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons - CC0 (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
